segments.caption: A news report details a serious collision in Douglasville, Georgia, where a train struck a red car on the tracks. The segment begins with a “NEW DETAILS” graphic, then shows aerial footage of the accident scene with emergency vehicles and a wrecked car pinned against a train engine. The report uses a map to pinpoint the location at the intersection of E Broad St and Mozley St, and features a reporter on location to provide updates on the incident.

A CBS Atlanta news report covers a train collision with a car in Douglasville, Georgia. The segment begins with a map graphic pinpointing the incident at the intersection of E Broad St and Mozley St, then transitions to a live on-site report by anchor Steve Kiggins. Standing at night in the area, Kiggins provides new details about the crash, with the map and the “TRAIN HITS CAR” headline remaining visible throughout the report.

A CBS Atlanta news reporter, Steve Kiggins, delivers a live report at night from the scene of a train collision in Douglasville, Douglas County. The segment features a reporter on location, construction workers inspecting the damage, and various vehicles, including a school bus, navigating the hazardous intersection under overcast skies. The footage highlights the immediate safety concerns and the disruption to traffic caused by the infrastructure failure.

The main event is a collision between a red car and a train, shown from an aerial view with emergency personnel on scene. The footage concludes with witnesses, including a man speaking to the camera and two women observing from the roadside, underscoring the community’s reaction to the dangerous event.
